detail.longDescription: Transcription for your own infrastructure. 🎙️ Aavaaz brings commercial-grade capabilities to your servers, combining real-time Whisper transcription, speaker identification, PII redaction, and scalable deployment in a fully open source solution. More control, more privacy, and no dependency on proprietary transcription services. https://www. collabora.com/news-and-blog/ne ws-and-events/introducing-aavaaz-self-hosted-production-ready-transcription-with-whisper.html # Aavaaz # SpeechRecognition # RealTimeTranscription # MachineLearning # OpenSourceAI
